author: Krogdalo
quote:
Imagine you get a game, at the end of 2026 and it TARGETS 30 FPS.

It dips constantly far below 30.

Tons of ghosting around the edges and around the characters.

Generally a weird visual with the forced vignette.

Gameplay has somehow kept its 2008 formula of heavily scripted missions with forced fail points if you dare deviate from the path + it got even worse by introducing what used to be optional 2-3 cutscene heavy relationship missions with what feels like a never ending onslaught of errands.

The world may be detailed but it lacks actual focus on things like: animation (stuff just plops out in your hand), you can barely enter buildings, look at Crimson Desert - not a single blocked building. NOT ONE. This is supposed to be the greatest open world sandbox?

Everything has become tedious. Stealing cars? Trackers. Minigames. Registrations. Constant repairs and refills.

Story: Utterly boring.

Gunplay: Same as 2008. Evolution is a forbidden word for Rockstar.

What are we doing here?
